description: High-value tuber crop requiring careful canopy health monitoring against fungal blights and pest infestations.

pathologies.name: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans)
pathologies.symptom: Water-soaked dark lesions with pale halo, rapid spread under high humidity

pathologies.name: Early Blight (Alternaria solani)
pathologies.symptom: Concentric target-board brown rings on older lower leaves

pathologies.name: Aphid Infestation (Myzus persicae)
pathologies.symptom: Leaf curling, honey dew accumulation, PLRV virus transmission vector

pathologies.name: Water Deficit Stress / Canopy Wilting
pathologies.symptom: Loss of leaf turgidity, canopy thinning, elevated leaf temperature

pathologies.name: Nitrogen / Potassium Deficiency (Chlorosis)
pathologies.symptom: General leaf yellowing starting from interveinal areas
